newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM CARGO TO LAUNCH TRIAL EXPRESS SERVICE.
newsitem.headline: KLM CARGO TO LAUNCH TRIAL EXPRESS SERVICE.

text.p: KLM Cargo will launch a new trial express service in July, specialising in shipments under 30 kilogrammes, a KLM Cargo spokesman said on Friday.
Initially named KLM Cargo Express, the new service will be tested for six months in six stations including Amsterdam, Brussels, London, New York, Dubai and Johannesburg.

The new airport-to-airport product is from KLM Cargo's Air Mail Services Business Unit. It will be possible to deliver cargo one hour before departure and pick-up in one hour after arrival, said the spokesman.
KLM Cargo also has Document Express which is for documents under 2.5 kilogrammes which must be in standard envelopes and not contain anything of value for the customs authorities.
This covers KLM's whole network whereas the new express service will be reserved for important destinations.
